verdict.rationale: Poly ships its own agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. However, all MCP evidence describes Poly acting as an MCP server that outside assistants connect to (hosted at mcp.poly.app, plus a Claude Code plugin). Nothing shows the Poly agent consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools, and server-side support does not count toward this client-side story.
